product_metadata.title: Atkins Iced Chai Tea Latte Protein Shake, 11 Fl Oz, Pack of 12
features: ATKINS ICED CHAI PROTEIN SHAKE. This is today’s Atkins. This creamy and delicious protein shake has the protein and the flavor to satisfy when it's meal time, no matter where you are.
STAY ON TRACK. Stay true the Atkins Diet and Lifestyle with our delicious protein shakes. Iced chai protein shakes have 1 gram of sugar per serving.

PROTEIN SHAKES AT HOME OR ON-THE-GO. Enjoy a creamy & satisfying protein shake that fits right into your busy schedule. With 15 grams of protein and 5 grams of fiber per serving, these shakes are perfect for your busy day.
ALL TASTE. NO COMPROMISE. Give your body the nutrients it needs without sacrificing your favorite flavors. Our protein shakes have all the sweetness you want in a snack without compromise.
QUALITY INGREDIENTS. Delight in the satisfying flavors and nutrients of Atkins protein shakes made with quality ingredients.
description: Enjoy Atkins® Iced Chai Protein Shake! Each creamy shake is packed with 15g of protein, 5g of fiber*, and 1g of sugar. Our protein shakes are the perfect way to eat a meal on the go and stay on track. The Atkins Lifestyle – The Atkins Diet and Lifestyle is the original, leading low-carb plan that provides effective and balanced weight loss by limiting carbs and sugar to help the body burn fat for fuel and keep your energy steady. Over 80 published clinical studies support that the science behind the principles of the Atkins Diet produces effective weight loss and long-term health benefits. ** Say goodbye to counting calories and say hello to today’s Atkins™. The perfect shake for a meal, how you want it and when you want it – Atkins® Iced Chai Protein Shake are the delicious way to grab a meal on the go that won’t sideline your nutritional goals. Stick with your low carb lifestyle without sacrificing on taste.
